Careers at Aurora Labs

Build software intelligence that actually ships.

A small, focused team solving execution-level problems that the rest of the industry approximates.

LOCI is becoming the quality gate for how the world writes software — across IDEs, pipelines, and autonomous agents. If you want to work on technology that is genuinely hard and genuinely useful, this is the place.

Why here

Reasons to join Aurora Labs.

We are selective about who we hire because we are serious about what we build.

Real Impact

Every line of production code that ships through LOCI represents a quality bar we raised. Your work is not a feature — it is infrastructure for the entire software-development industry.

Hard Problems

We build proprietary LLMs trained on real software workloads and platform traces, not synthetic benchmarks. The unsolved problems here are genuinely unsolved — we solve them daily.

Exceptional Team

300+ cumulative engineering years across ML, compilers, embedded systems, and developer platforms. The people you will work with are the best in their domain.

Meaningful Equity

$97M raised. Backed by Toyota Tsusho, Porsche, LG, and others. Early enough for your equity to matter; mature enough for your work to ship.

Culture

How we work day to day.

We do not have a culture deck. We have decisions we make every day that reflect what we actually care about.

Aurora Labs is a place where engineers think deeply, move deliberately, and take pride in the quality of what they produce. Titles matter less than judgment.

High Ownership

Engineers own problems end-to-end — from design to production. No hand-offs, no committees. You decide, you ship, you learn.

Clarity Over Process

We keep meetings intentional and documentation honest. If a process isn't earning its weight, we cut it.

Async by Default

Deep work is protected. Most coordination happens in writing so that your focus block is yours.

Candid Feedback

We say what we think, directly and respectfully. Disagreement is expected and welcomed — especially before a decision is made.

Craft Matters

We take quality seriously at every layer — the model, the API, the CLI, the docs. Attention to detail is a shared value, not an exception.

Remote-Friendly

Our team spans multiple time zones. We hire for talent and trust, not proximity.
